- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a recipe for homemade beeswax wraps, including ingredients and instructions:
  - Ingredients: 1 cup beeswax pellets, 1/2 cup jojoba oil, 1/4 cup pine resin (optional), cotton or hemp fabric, scissors, paintbrush or sponge, oven or double boiler.
  - Instructions: Preheat oven, cut fabric, melt beeswax, mix in jojoba oil and pine resin, brush mixture onto fabric, cool and harden.

  4. Mason Cash wraps
  5. Silicone wraps
